clues: Its cathedral holds the best preserved of the four surviving original copies of the 1215 Magna Carta.
John Constable painted its cathedral from the nearby water meadows.
It was founded in the 1220s when the bishop moved down from the hilltop fort of Old Sarum.
Its cathedral spire, at 123m, is the tallest in Britain.
It is the nearest city to Stonehenge, in Wiltshire.
